title: What's New: Cost Adjustment (2025 release wave 1)

features.name: Iterative adjustment for high-volume items
features.description: Allows cost adjustment on a period by period basis through the inventory cost adjustment page. Users can select an item, choose a date, and run adjust cost until valuation date to handle large transaction volumes.
caveats: Limited to one run per period

features.name: Specific order adjustment
features.description: Enables adjustment of specific production and assembly orders by selecting individual orders and choosing adjust cost for selected orders.

features.name: Item by item commit
features.description: Reduces lock times and prevents full reruns if one item fails. Activated via the adjust cost item entries report with item by item adjustment toggle.
caveats: Only available in adjust cost item entries report

features.name: Mark for adjustment action
features.description: Forces rerun of cost adjustment for items that are marked as adjusted but carry incorrect costs. Mark inbound entries for adjustment to recalculate linked outbound entries.
caveats: For old or highly customized environments

features.name: Item Application Entries page with reset action
features.description: New page allowing reset of outbound entries to reprocess them in the next cost adjustment, ensuring entries are reconsidered.

features.name: Cost adjustment self-diagnostics
features.description: Automatically scans setup and cost adjustment data to detect potential issues. Displays notifications and lists warnings about inefficiencies, settings, inventory periods, production orders, and data discrepancies.
caveats: Can be snoozed up to 30 days

features.name: Cost adjustment tracer tool
features.description: Analyzes cost adjustment process by recording events, processed entries, items, locations, variances, production and assembly orders, and cost differences. Creates a log saved to database for troubleshooting.
caveats: Timeout can be set up to 12 hours
Log can be too large to analyze manually
